I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, moving over to the right to make my exit, when the vehicle
in the adjacent lane drifted into my car and sideswiped the passenger side of my vehicle. I checked my mrirors and
signaled before moving, and I did not see the other car until contact was made. The impact pushed my car toward the
shoulder and I had to grip the wheel hard to bring it under control. I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed in the vehicle
until help arrived. I have told this same account every time I have described what happened, to the officer at the
scene, to the adjuster and to my doctor. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating the insured vehicle
with the owner's permission. Since the collision I have been treated for a back strain, with stiffness and pain in my
lower back that limits how long I can sit or lift.
